kvm_command_inventory.corpus_policy: Every arch/arm64/kvm C command context plus every compiled virt/kvm C source in the pinned successful defconfig build.

environment.source_policy: Linux source and headers came from a clean detached worktree. The successful Kbuild database had only its absolute source-root prefix relocated to that worktree; compiler arguments and the out-of-tree generated headers were preserved.

measurements.name: counted-by-common-context-differential
measurements.interpretation: The baseline tree carried only unrelated untracked review reports. Every common ARM64 KVM context lost exactly its once-per-process unknown __counted_by__ diagnostic; no other warning class changed.

compatibility_changes: Retain and validate GCC counted_by associations on flexible arrays and GCC 16 structure pointer fields, including integral bit-field counters.
Give __builtin_counted_by_ref its field-dependent pointer type and counter address, so Linux allocation wrappers update the real count field.
Return typed void-pointer null for unannotated arrays and pointer fields without evaluating their operand, matching GCC side-effect behavior.
Reject malformed associations, function-pointer fields, pointers to structures containing flexible arrays, and standalone pointer operands.

covered_behavior: single evaluation for an annotated side-effecting operand
no evaluation and null result for an unannotated side-effecting operand

cases: pointer to a structure with a flexible array

semantic_validation.real_kvm_normalization: The exact virt/kvm/irqchip.c command expands kzalloc_flex() to a write through __builtin_counted_by_ref, normalized as __obj_ptr->nr_rt_entries = __count.

model_limitations: Eva does not yet consume counted_by metadata as a general flexible-array bounds invariant; this milestone preserves the association and models the counter-reference builtin.
GCC 16 pointer-field support does not yet model GCC dynamic-object-size or bounds-sanitizer behavior.
Remaining architecture attributes and inline-assembly effects are classified but are not precise ARM64 KVM verification semantics.

validation.optional_lint_wrappers: not available in the opam switch: ocp-indent.dynlink and headache are missing

next_semantic_targets: Use counted_by metadata to constrain flexible-array accesses in Eva and kernel-specific checks.
Add ownership, cleanup, and lock-state checks across generic virt/kvm and ARM64 KVM call paths.
Model selected ARM64 system-register and privileged-assembly boundaries needed by fresh bug analyses.
interpretation: Typed means preprocessing, parsing, type-checking, normalization, and Metrics completed for all selected Kbuild contexts. It does not prove KVM correctness. Unlike v3's compatibility fallback, v4 preserves the flexible-array-to-counter relationship and normalizes Linux's generated counter writes, providing semantic input for later bounds verification.
